Brazos County is the heart of the Bryan–College Station metro and home to Texas A&M University and its 70,000-plus students. The university drives a student-housing and research-park economy — development tracks the campus edge and the RELLIS corridor — and enrollment growth, more than general in-migration, sets the pace of the market.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 22, 2026
